annotation.title_clean: Egypt charts a path towards ethical and inclusive AI with UNESCO support
annotation.title_en: Egypt charts a path towards ethical and inclusive AI with UNESCO support
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: UNESCO news item announcing the launch of Egypt's AI Readiness Assessment Report, produced with the Ministry of Communications and IT using UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology and anchored in the 2021 Recommendation on the Ethics of AI. It highlights Egypt's National AI Strategy 2025-2030 and recommends investment and regulatory reforms.
key_provisions_or_claims: Egypt completed UNESCO's Readiness Assessment Methodology, funded by EU DG INTPA.
Assessment anchored in the UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI (2021).
Notes Egypt's National AI Strategy 2025-2030 and National Council for AI.
Identifies priorities: computing infrastructure, capacity building, stronger regulatory frameworks.
Report is intended as a roadmap and for regional peer learning, with an Arabic translation.
